text:
```yaml
name: Remove Experimental Decorators

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 1 * *'

jobs:
  remove-experimental-decorators:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run script to remove experimental decorators
        id: remove_decorators
        run: |
          SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE=0
          python dev/remove_experimental_decorators.py || SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE=$?
          echo "::set-output name=script_exit_code::$SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE"
          if [ "$SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "Script failed with exit code $SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE"
          fi

      - name: Create PR if changes were made
        if: steps.remove_decorators.outputs.script_exit_code != '0'
        run: |
          BRANCH_NAME="automated/remove-experimental-decorators-$(date +%Y-%m-%d-%H-%M-%S)"
          git checkout -b $BRANCH_NAME
          git add .
          git commit -m "Automated removal of experimental decorators"
          gh pr create \
            --title "Automated removal of experimental decorators" \
            --body-file /tmp/pr_body.txt \
            --label automated \
            --base main \
            --head $BRANCH_NAME

      - name: Log completion
        if: always()
        run: echo "Workflow completed."
```
